description: Phase 1: rebrand + remove all external cloud/telemetry/auth/update dependencies while keeping local agent execution.

userStories.title: Rebrand package.json build metadata
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want the desktop app's package.json to carry Halotec branding so the binary, appId, protocol, and publish URL all reflect the local-first fork.
acceptanceCriteria: productName = 'Halotec Code'
appId = 'id.halotec.code'
homepage removed or replaced with internal placeholder
protocol scheme = 'halotec-code'
publish.url replaced (no cdn.21st.dev)

userStories.title: Remove posthog / sentry / electron-updater dependencies
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want telemetry and update deps removed from package.json so the install footprint and audit surface are clean.
acceptanceCriteria: posthog-js removed from dependencies
posthog-node removed from dependencies
@sentry/electron removed from dependencies
electron-updater removed from dependencies
bun install completes without dep-resolution failure for these packages

userStories.title: Replace analytics.ts with no-op exports (main + renderer)
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want the analytics modules to keep their public surface but do nothing, so existing callers compile and run unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: src/main/lib/analytics.ts exports track/identify/optOut/etc as no-op functions
src/renderer/lib/analytics.ts exports track/identify/optOut/etc as no-op functions
no posthog-js or posthog-node import remains in either file

userStories.title: Strip Sentry init/imports from main, preload, renderer
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want all Sentry integration removed so the app has no third-party error reporting surface.
acceptanceCriteria: No @sentry/electron import in src/main/index.ts
No Sentry.* import in src/preload/index.ts
No Sentry.* import in src/renderer/*
No IPC channels for Sentry remain in preload API surface

userStories.title: Replace auto-updater with no-op + remove update IPC + hide update UI
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want in-app update checks disabled, the IPC handlers removed, and the update UI hidden so the app never contacts cdn.21st.dev.
acceptanceCriteria: src/main/lib/auto-updater.ts becomes a no-op module that exports the same public surface
update-related IPC handlers removed from src/main/index.ts
src/renderer/lib/hooks/use-update-checker.ts becomes a no-op hook returning { available: false }
Update UI affordances hidden or removed in renderer

userStories.title: LocalAuthService replacing cloud auth (auth-store, oauth, consumers)
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want the auth layer to be a local-only stub so there is no token exchange, refresh, or remote API call.
acceptanceCriteria: src/main/lib/auth/local-auth-service.ts exists with LocalAuthService
No remote HTTP calls in auth flow (no /api/auth/*, no exchange, no refresh)
Always returns a local user/profile (id/email/name from a configurable local identity)
All consumers in main/index.ts and renderer use LocalAuthService
userStories.notes: Commit 48307b0. LocalAuthService at src/main/lib/auth/local-auth-service.ts. auth-manager.ts is now a 13-LOC re-export shim (option A). 15+ consumer files unchanged. handleAuthCode cookie block + setOnTokenRefresh cookie block removed from main/index.ts. getBaseUrl/getAppUrl return localhost placeholder. auth-store.ts and oauth.ts untouched.

userStories.title: Hide subscription / Pro / Max / cloud-agent / remote-sandbox / 1code.dev API UI
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want all paid-tier and cloud-only UI affordances removed or hidden so users don't see features the local fork does not support.
acceptanceCriteria: No Pro/Max/billing UI surfaces remain in renderer (or are visibly disabled with a 'local-only build' notice)
No 'background cloud agent' affordance
No 'remote sandbox import' or 1code.dev API task UI
renderer/lib/remote-trpc.ts and remote-api.ts removed or stubbed to throw/no-op
userStories.notes: Commit 7c0a563. remote-trpc.ts and remote-api.ts rewritten as no-op stubs. All 21 tRPC methods across agents/automations/github/linear/teams return safe defaults (empty arrays, { type: 'free' }, { connected: false }, no-op mutations). All 11 remote-api methods either return [] or throw 'local-only' error. 15+ consumer files unchanged — they see empty remote backend, which hides every Pro/Max/background-cloud-agent/remote-sandbox/1code.dev-API affordance (no data → no UI). Validation: tsc 116 errors (baseline 118, -2 fixed), bun build succeeded in 5m with 8GB heap. Side benefit: subscription check in agents-beta-tab returns { type: 'free' }, paid-plan gate stays closed in non-dev.

userStories.title: rg sweep clean for 21st.dev / 1code.dev / posthog / sentry / electron-updater / cdn.21st
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want a final grep to confirm no external references remain in source.
acceptanceCriteria: rg -n '21st\.dev|1code\.dev|posthog|sentry|electron-updater|cdn\.21st' src/ package.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md returns 0 hits (excluding build outputs and node_modules)
userStories.notes: Commit 955e0a1. 23 files touched. rg -n '21st\.dev|1code\.dev|posthog|sentry|electron-updater|cdn\.21st' on src/ + package.json + CONTRIBUTING.md returns 0 hits. README.md has 7 hits remaining — handled by US-010 (which rewrites the README as a local-first narrative). Other notable changes: author → Halotec/code@halotec.my.id in package.json; CSP in src/renderer/index.html drops posthog and 21st.dev from script-src and connect-src (security hardening); src/main/lib/config.ts getApiUrl() returns '' sentinel in packaged builds; src/main/windows/main.ts trusted origins → ['localhost','127.0.0.1']; src/main/index.ts Help menu Learn More → empty (no upstream project page); sidebar Automations button handleClick + agents-help-popover changelog/release handlers + update-banner handleOpenChangelog + use-just-updated openChangelog all stripped of openExternal remote URLs. Validation: tsc 116 errors (baseline 116, no regressions), 1 new error caught and fixed (missing getApiUrl import in chats.ts after switching to dynamic URL). Build skipped (5+ min; cosmetic-only changes outside type-checked paths).

userStories.title: Run bun install + ts:check + build
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want the build pipeline to run end-to-end so the fork is shippable.
acceptanceCriteria: bun install completes (no dep-resolution failure)
bun run ts:check completes (tsgo or tsc fallback)
bun run build produces out/

userStories.title: README local-first security notes + removed-cloud-features section
userStories.description: As a Halotec operator, I want the README to document that this is a local-first fork and list which cloud features were removed.
acceptanceCriteria: README has a 'Local-first / removed cloud features' section listing: telemetry, Sentry, auto-update, cloud auth, Pro/Max/subscription, background cloud agents, 1code.dev API
README notes where local data is stored (userData, ~/.halotec-code)
